"We're gonna start off with a basic little template a white like a white plain field make the player character like a Roblox character a little more cue base and stuff like that and the first thing we're gonna add is the movement system and combat there's gonna be player and there's gonna be a dummy to test combat on the dummy is always gonna be like punching and along with that The player is going to have 3 main ways of attacking or offense in general the first one is a basic punch the second 1 is a heavy punch and the third 1 is a stationary Dodge dodge can be both ways stationary or not depending if the player is in sprint mode or not if the player is sprinting Dodge will be a jump kind of like a - away but if it's not Dodge will be Like a slip when you're in a fighting game like you can slip an attack when an attack is slipped it will give the player a little damage boost or not usually a damage boost but a quickness for their heavy attack like they get a 0.2 second window to execute a fast heavy attack that does a little more damage But mainly Focus on these 3 things I'm gonna give you the stamina bar the HP bar and the food bar they're all going to be in the top right The health bar is the biggest one and it's 100/100 and  the stamina  90/90 hunger 80/80

A basic punch will do about 4 damage to 6 damage(if its a critical)
A heavy does 10 damage and can do 14 with a critical

 An M1 can have a string of 4 attacks a it starts with a jab another jab a cross and then it finishes off with an uppercut
 There is a combo string I call combo string one that can be put together with the M2 it can be    m1>m1>m2  That will cut the normal combo short and launch the target into the air  That's all it does for now no like the player jumps up and air combos them that's not available yet but like that's all it does for now

## Objective
- Build a complete playable browser game prototype for a white-floor combat training arena with a blocky player, punching dummy, movement, dodging, combat combos, and status bars.

## Requirements
- Player and dummy in a plain white arena; dummy attacks the player.
- Basic punch: 4 damage, 6 critical. Heavy punch: 10 damage, 14 critical.
- Four-hit M1 string: jab, jab, cross, uppercut. M1>M1>M2 cuts the string short and launches the dummy; no air combo.
- Dodge is a stationary slip when not sprinting, or a backward dash when sprinting. A successful slip opens a 0.2-second faster, stronger heavy attack window.
- Top-right bars: health 100/100, stamina 90/90, hunger 80/80; health bar largest.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML/CSS/Canvas game without libraries.
- Added keyboard, mouse, and mobile touch controls; dummy periodically resets after defeat.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created arena UI, responsive HUD, blocky canvas characters, controls, combat, dummy counterattacks, meters, reset and KO states.
- `node --check game.js` passed; browser opened successfully and initial screenshot inspected.
- Fixed rapid M1>M1>M2 input by buffering attacks during the end of the current attack.

### Active
- Validate combo, slip/heavy boost, movement, and responsive mobile experience.
- Remove temporary debug exposure and verify gameplay state after recent input-buffering change.

### Blocked
- Browser check found a combo test result of `92 / 100` dummy health rather than expected launch damage; exact runtime behavior still needs diagnosis. A temporary `window.__debugGame = game` was added to `game.js` for investigation.

2. Remove temporary `window.__debugGame` instrumentation and run focused tests for combo, dodge slip, heavy, and movement.
3. Check mobile layout and capture a fresh JPEG screenshot after gameplay validation.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game UI, HUD, controls, and status display.
- `style.css`: arena UI and responsive/mobile styling.
- `game.js`: canvas rendering, controls, movement, combat and game state.
